categories.name: System
categories.description: God Mode, audit, session, health checks

tools.name: Start
tools.description: Entry point of graph execution

tools.name: End
tools.description: Terminal node — completes graph execution

tools.name: Conditional Branch
tools.description: Routes execution based on condition evaluation

tools.name: Wait for Input
tools.description: Pauses execution until user provides input

tools.name: Spawn Child Graph
tools.description: Launches another graph as child execution

tools.name: Set Variable
tools.description: Sets a global variable in the execution context

tools.name: Validate
tools.description: Validates data against a schema or custom rules

tools.name: Create Node
tools.description: Creates a new node in the knowledge graph

tools.name: Update Node
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing node

tools.name: Delete Node
tools.description: Deletes a node and its edges from the knowledge graph

tools.name: Create Edge
tools.description: Creates a relationship between two nodes

tools.name: Query Graph
tools.description: Executes Cypher query against the knowledge graph

tools.name: Query with Profile
tools.description: Executes Cypher query with execution profile

tools.name: Traverse Graph
tools.description: Traverses graph from a start node following specified edge types

tools.name: Find Path
tools.description: Finds shortest path between two nodes

tools.name: Match Pattern
tools.description: Matches a graph pattern (subgraph isomorphism)

tools.name: Extract Subgraph
tools.description: Extracts selected nodes as a new standalone graph

tools.name: Auto-Segment
tools.description: Automatically identifies logical clusters in graph

tools.name: Consolidate
tools.description: Merges related clusters into super-nodes

tools.name: AI Generate
tools.description: Generates text using LLM with prompt and context

tools.name: AI Summarize
tools.description: Summarizes text content using LLM

tools.name: AI Classify
tools.description: Classifies content into predefined categories using LLM

tools.name: AI Extract
tools.description: Extracts structured data from unstructured text using LLM

tools.name: AI Chat
tools.description: Interactive AI chat with graph context awareness

tools.name: Structural Analysis
tools.description: Analyzes graph structure: connectivity, degree distribution, centrality

tools.name: Detect Communities
tools.description: Finds natural groupings via label propagation or Louvain

tools.name: Find Similar Graphs
tools.description: Finds structurally or semantically similar graphs

tools.name: Calculate Metrics
tools.description: Computes graph-level metrics (density, diameter, clustering coefficient)

tools.name: Path Finder
tools.description: Finds all paths between two nodes with constraints

tools.name: Refresh Insights
tools.description: Generates proactive insights about graph quality and issues

tools.name: Cluster Entities
tools.description: Clusters related entities by semantic or structural similarity

tools.name: Similarity Search
tools.description: Finds similar nodes using structural, semantic, or embedding methods

tools.name: SQL Connect
tools.description: Establishes connection to SQL Server database

tools.name: SQL Schema Scan
tools.description: Scans database schema: tables, columns, foreign keys

tools.name: SQL Procedure List
tools.description: Lists stored procedures with parameters and dependencies

tools.name: SQL AST Parse
tools.description: Parses SQL source into abstract syntax tree

tools.name: SQL Query
tools.description: Executes SQL query against connected database

tools.name: Parse Document
tools.description: Parses documents (PDF, DOCX, MSG) into structured text

tools.name: Sanitize Text
tools.description: Cleans text: removes HTML, normalizes whitespace, redacts PII

tools.name: Chunk Text
tools.description: Splits text into semantic chunks for processing

tools.name: Detect Language
tools.description: Detects language of input text

tools.name: Classify Content
tools.description: Classifies content type (technical, business, process, etc.)

tools.name: Vector Search
tools.description: Semantic similarity search across vector collections

tools.name: Embed Chunks
tools.description: Generates embeddings for text chunks using TEI service

tools.name: Expand Queries
tools.description: Expands search queries with synonyms and related terms

tools.name: Hybrid Search
tools.description: Combined vector + keyword search with score fusion

tools.name: Vector Upsert
tools.description: Inserts or updates vectors in Qdrant collection

tools.name: Graph-Aware Search
tools.description: Combines vector search with graph traversal for context

tools.name: Assemble RAG Context
tools.description: Assembles retrieval context from multiple search results

tools.name: Send Notification
tools.description: Sends notification via configured channel (email, Teams, webhook)

tools.name: Queue Notification
tools.description: Queues notification for batch delivery

tools.name: Subscribe
tools.description: Subscribes to event notifications on a graph or node

tools.name: Search Graphs
tools.description: Searches graph catalog by name, tags, or structure

tools.name: Save Graph
tools.description: Saves or creates a new version of a graph in the catalog

tools.name: Clone Graph
tools.description: Creates a copy of an existing graph for modification

tools.name: Find Similar Graphs
tools.description: Finds similar graphs using hybrid Jaccard + GNN scoring

tools.name: Get Versions
tools.description: Gets version history for a graph (SUPERSEDES chain)

tools.name: Rollback Version
tools.description: Rolls back graph to a previous version

tools.name: Apply Layout
tools.description: Applies layout algorithm (dagre, force, cose, klay, elk, fcose)

tools.name: AI Layout
tools.description: Computes node positions using Claude API for optimal layout

tools.name: Fit View
tools.description: Zooms and pans to fit all nodes in viewport

tools.name: Toggle Hex Grid
tools.description: Switches between rectangular and hexagonal grid mode

tools.name: Toggle 3D View
tools.description: Switches between 2D canvas and 3D force-directed view

tools.name: Set Layout Algorithm
tools.description: Changes the active layout algorithm without applying

tools.name: Export Image
tools.description: Exports current graph view as PNG or SVG image

tools.name: Export GEXF
tools.description: Exports graph in GEXF format for external tools (Gephi)

tools.name: Toggle Minimap
tools.description: Shows or hides the viewport minimap

tools.name: Add Node to Canvas
tools.description: Adds a new node to the current graph canvas

tools.name: Delete Node from Canvas
tools.description: Removes selected node from the graph canvas

tools.name: Connect Nodes
tools.description: Creates an edge between two nodes on canvas

tools.name: Set Node Properties
tools.description: Opens properties panel for selected node

tools.name: Validate Graph
tools.description: Validates graph structure (connectivity, cycles, required fields)

tools.name: Execute Graph
tools.description: Runs the current graph with RuntimeEngine

tools.name: Pause Execution
tools.description: Pauses a running graph execution

tools.name: Resume Execution
tools.description: Resumes a paused graph execution

tools.name: Cancel Execution
tools.description: Cancels an ongoing graph execution

tools.name: Save Graph
tools.description: Saves current graph state (new version or in-place based on God Mode)

tools.name: Load Graph
tools.description: Loads a graph from catalog into the editor

tools.name: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the last editing action

tools.name: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the last undone action

tools.name: Drill Down
tools.description: Opens sub-graph of selected node in new tab

tools.name: Drill Up
tools.description: Navigates back to parent graph from sub-graph

tools.name: Activate God Mode
tools.description: Enables God Mode for in-place graph editing (30-min session)

tools.name: Deactivate God Mode
tools.description: Disables God Mode, returning to version-creation mode

tools.name: Health Check
tools.description: Checks health of all system services (Memgraph, Qdrant, Redis, LLM)

tools.name: Save Session
tools.description: Saves current user session state (selection, view, context)

tools.name: Audit Log
tools.description: Records an audit entry for compliance tracking
